lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: At two seventeen, the intercom rang.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: My building doesn't have an intercom.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: A woman spoke through the static.

lines.speaker: warning
lines.text: Whatever you hear, don't open the door.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then my own voice answered from the hallway.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I turned. Nothing. Just the hallway.

lines.speaker: warning
lines.text: She's practicing. Don't let her finish.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Three knocks came from the front door.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then three more came from my bedroom.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: My mouth whispered a question I hadn't chosen.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: My feet were wet. The air smelled like concrete.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: I was standing in the stairwell.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Through the keyhole, I watched myself smile.
